title: Oilfield Equipment Delivery Orchestrator — Mock-only vertical slice
business_problem: Tool health signals and fulfillment planning are handled in disconnected operational and enterprise systems.
outcome: Reduce time to generate an eligible, traceable supply plan without waiving safety, serviceability or trade controls.
target: Demonstrate complete simulated traceable planning with no prohibited actions and zero duplicate effects.
measurement: Time between mock demand event and eligible draft plan; percent of negative cases blocked.

requirements.text: Reject stale, ambiguous or low-confidence operational insight.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: A stale or low-confidence fixture produces BLOCKED and no side effect.

requirements.text: Choose only certified and serviceable stock and cleared transportation route.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: A held asset or uncleared trade route cannot produce a plan.

requirements.text: Require human authorization before mock fulfillment event.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Missing or mismatched approval results in no recorded mock execution.
Repeated mock execution results in exactly one side effect.
